svg.title: Keep the rejected statements visible
svg.desc: Eight exact failures prevent common overgeneralizations. Red “FALSIFIED” nodes are the old claims; red-role “PROVED” nodes are their verified counterexamples.

g.title: Every linearly minimal compatible realization has unique entropy.
A locally isolated physical generator is the only compatible generator.
No connected hidden realization exists at or above zc=(11+sqrt(1120/11))/2.
Strictly positive factors of each finite block Hankel truncation imply a strict same-order CTMC realization.
An exactly identified and continuously recovered generator has locally bounded entropy.
Approaching a compact set of irreducible generators is sufficient for entropy continuity or a finite ceiling.
A uniform bound on reciprocal rate ratios gives a uniform entropy-rate upper bound without a time/activity constraint.
Two fully hidden states always defeat local entropy ceilings even under any extra cap containing the source.

The symmetric complete four-state Q0 has entropy zero and full linear order four. At ε=1/4 the exact normalized hidden similarity gives Q=[[-6,1,3/2,7/2],[1,-10,3,6],[5/3,11/3,-29/4,23/12],[3,5,3/4,-35/4]], with the same all-time kernel and σ=(1/16)log(529/154)>0; ε→2/3 produces unbounded entropy.

Theta(3,3) is actually isolated by an exact positive tangent dual and nonsingular chart, yet U=(1/1000)[[871,-390,519],[623,790,-413],[-183,133,1050]] yields a distant complete generator with the same kernel. det U=34813/31250 and its minimum offdiagonal rate is 139/500; a further exact family has divergent entropy.

A fixed exact rational normalized similarity gives complete generators for every z in [2109/200,21091/2000]=[10.545,10.5455], an interval crossing zc≈10.5452497911. Every offdiagonal is strictly positive and the full kernel is preserved.

At theta(100,100), every finite truncation of the uniformized three-mode hidden response has positive inner-dimension-three factors for a sufficiently small truncation-dependent ε. Nevertheless the physical cap-five generator is globally unique; the proposed similarity has hidden rate ε(-197+194ε)/(1-ε²)<0 for 0<ε<1.

The unit three-state tree is approached by Q(e,k)=[[-1-e,1,e],[1,-2+k,1-k],[k,1-e,-1+e-k]], 0<k<e<1/2. Every model is uniquely identified at cap three and has trace -4, rates ≤1 and minimal order three. With k=exp(-1/e²), Q→Q0 but eσ→1/3.

The divergent three-state chord family converges to the singleton unit tree, a compact irreducible limit set with positive rates on its own support. New edge rates vanish at unequal speeds and carry divergent entropy.
On a three-cycle, clockwise rates 2c and reverse rates c have ratio R=2 for every c>0, but σ=c log 2→∞ as c→∞.

For N=4, fixed trace -12 and all twelve offdiagonal rates ≤1 force every rate to equal one. The restricted class is a singleton with zero entropy, despite two fully hidden states for one observed pair.
Every four-state exact entropy fiber is singleton or unbounded; unknown support has only two unique incidence classes.
The balanced theta family has unbounded, two-point, then singleton entropy fibers across an exact quartic threshold.
A strictly positive three-state triangle has locally Lipschitz entropy in row TV.
For one resolved pair, a finite local entropy ceiling exists exactly at N=2 or a complete N=3 triangle.
Compact inverse control suffices only when disappearing new edges are also excluded.
